sources.title: Engineering Analysis EA26002 FSD visibility
sources.excerpt: Date opened03/18/2026, prompted byPE24031. Subject FSD Collisions in Reduced Roadway Visibility Conditions. Estimated population3,203,754. Summary table9 crashes,2 injury incidents,1 fatality. Engineering analysis evaluates camera-only ADAS degradation detection and driver warnings under reduced visibility. Available incident data raise concerns detection/alerts fail appropriately under glare and airborne obscurants. Tesla internal data/labeling limitations could have led to under-reporting. Investigation opening is not a final defect/liability finding; ODI also examining six recent potentially related incidents.

sources.title: Tesla renames Full Self Driving in Europe
sources.excerpt: October9 2026 Reuters: Tesla European websites rename Full Self-Driving to Tesla Assisted Driving after German regulator pushback. Several regulators call previous name misleading because system requires constant supervision and drivers remain legally responsible. Eight EU countries allow system; Slovakia expected ninth. EU-wide vote pushed fromOctober to at leastDecember, France conducting more testing. Hosted byEuronext; publisherReuters.

price.note: Regular close, not after-hours; current post-split common-stock basis. Primary issuer EPS is on same split basis.

shares.note: Exact July16 issuer count, independently repeated by current vendor without share measurement date; treated as quote-date approximation, not observed fresh actual shares. Includes restricted shares in issued/outstanding but not all potential weighted-average EPS dilution.

market_cap.note: Both publishers report rounded1.51T; rounding retained, no fabricated precision. Quote-date share estimate reconciles within policy tolerance.

revenue.note: Consolidated annual revenue; millions normalized to dollars.

net_income.note: GAAP consolidated income attributable to common stockholders, not total income including noncontrolling interests.

operating_cash_flow.note: GAAP annual operating cash flow; SBC and working capital are included.

capital_expenditure.note: Positive cash capital spend normalized from negative investing outflow; includes energy generation/storage capital purchases, excludes finance lease noncash additions.

eps.note: GAAP annual diluted EPS, current split basis; not vendor forward or adjusted EPS.

cash.note: Consolidated cash/equivalents only, excludes28.305B short-term investments and1.206B restricted cash (496M current plus710M noncurrent). Not called unrestricted distributable owner cash.
